kind: source-bound author manuscript mathematics and static reference QA
reviewer_role: Independent read-only manuscript/math subagent; author revision support, not a new referee decision

manual_review.name: Original Bellman objective, existence, selection, stability and full computation graph
manual_review.finding: Checked finite-horizon continuity and Borel selection, history-policy comparison, nonexpansiveness, terminal residual accounting, own-future cone construction, original feasible repairs and critic/actor chain-rule qualifications. The retained infinite-horizon assertion uses its additional stationary discount and selection premises.
manual_review.limits: Effective covers, feasible repairs, certified integration and original risk assumptions remain premises. Exact ReLU/min-plus realizability is not convergence of a neural training optimizer or an exclusive representational advantage.

manual_review.name: Original continuous-risk marginal and boundary-constrained tail
manual_review.finding: Checked the same two-date investment model and original continuous uniform innovations, upper-cost AVaR, strong convexity, constrained central-tail cut and envelope derivative. Fixed-density envelope differentiation and finite outward derivative labels retain the original objective. Convex-order integration bounds do not redefine the innovation law.
manual_review.limits: The experiment buys labels from the original optimal V1 primitive; it does not numerically validate a long composition of learned continuation operators. The all-state service totalization cited for inference concerns the prescribed dyadic initial-state population; arbitrary real-state acquisition transfer is separate.

manual_review.name: Paid support to action information and safe complete-policy improvement
manual_review.finding: Checked the producer's fixed feasible risk-density support, original Q upper before the separately added future allowance, asymmetric derivative intervals, constant-curvature sharpness witnesses, endpoint counterexample, actual-displacement safeguards and gain telescoping. The three tests separately cover strict gain, original regret and objective width.
manual_review.limits: Sharpness is restricted to exact support slope and the exact untruncated information class. The implemented finite dyadic radii and global gradient cap need not be sharp. The inner dyadic capacity is used for actual menu construction. Precision-rate guarantees require the stated oracle assumptions and do not remove the curvature/future-policy width floor. Priced stopping is only the compulsory-cost single-decision dominance region.

manual_review.name: Post-freeze matching gain bounds at the exact paid-support information interface
manual_review.finding: Checked that every exact derivative in the untruncated interior interval has a common constant-L witness satisfying the complete global support. A single endpoint witness attains the randomized expected contrast, with variance term, without exchanging a supremum and an expectation. The arbitrary future-error interface adds delta times the probability of a nonzero displacement; conditioning on replacement proves the matching deterministic/ randomized bound, including exact incumbent retention and zero-gain edge cases.
manual_review.limits: This explicitly post-F analytic deduction changes no frozen procedure or numerical outcomes. It concerns only the specified scalar exact-p information class and feasible actions with no extra queries; it is not minimax optimality of the implemented finite-radius/capped/menu service, a realized investment-model lower bound, neural exclusivity, an acquisition/query complexity bound, or a cost/adoption conclusion. Complete-policy qualification and objective-width tests remain separate.

manual_review.name: Joint conditional inference for the frozen original policies
manual_review.finding: Checked the independent dyadic state law, common original-policy support, paired numerical enclosures, exact same-method identity rule, self-contained bounded-mean proof, rational exponential witness and one-sided binomial inversion. The 116 safe means, 232 threshold events and 348 signed comparisons use the same 32 initial states and the 0.01/0.01/0.03 union-bound allocation.
manual_review.limits: Coverage is conditional on fixed inherited actors and frozen rules, valid numerical enclosures and the uniform original-policy qualification premises on P40. The explicit computational-scope paragraph distinguishes finite dyadic exact-rational totalization from measured wall-time/memory and from unproved transfer to a continuous initial-state population. The proof-supported intersection does not independently confirm its sharper gain bound. Same sampled actions for different keys imply sample zero only. Own-incumbent gain does not prove neural-specific superiority or adoption; price regions and repeated clocks are not added population observations.

manual_review.name: Recursive utility and stochastic-control interface
manual_review.finding: Checked decoupled Brownian forward well-posedness, Lipschitz BSDE fixed-point argument, original driver/sign/filtration, residual linearization, bounded-coefficient Girsanov integrability and the boundary-inclusive stopped certificate. The full z=Sigma-transpose-gradient graph is required.
manual_review.limits: Optimizing-control attainment requires separate conditions; the infimum suffices for verification. Generic fully coupled or general-martingale NDU/FBSDE remains open. ReLU classical C2 use is not licensed, and investment-policy numerical values are not transferred to another recursive utility.

static_source_reference_audit.scope: Union of actual source inputs for four cross-linked TeX wrappers; actual TeX logs and PDF rendering are separately required.

scientific_status: No claim of completed R122 execution, independent economic audit, CI success or final package. Those require their actual source-bound receipts.
mathematical_result: No material defect identified in the specifically reviewed chains under their stated assumptions and scope. This is a human-readable analytical review, not formal verification or a new proof of all historical results.
final_pdf_qa_status: Requires separately identified final four-document build, log verification and visual inspection.
